$comment: Teaching level 2 (overhaul, paced S3): worship races on a 128 map. The hill shrine (90 s prayer) is a safe warm-up; the shrine in the pass (30 s) races the rival, whose worshippers set out at minute 2; then the ley stone must be kept 200 s while those worshippers try to pray it away. Three posted wardens guard it, but a lone worshipper still flips it in about 80 s unless the player strikes it down (Lightning, Bolt or the Watchtower).
name: The Contested Shrine
description: Two shrines and a ley stone lie between you and a rival tribe. Take the hill shrine, win the race to the shrine in the pass, then keep the ley stone while their worshippers try to pray it away: strike them down. Four praying followers work at full speed.

rewards.text: Lightning is yours. The shrine in the pass is next: the rival is already stirring.
The pass shrine is yours: two more Lightnings and three Bolts. Now hold the ley stone.
The ley stone is yours and pays mana while you hold it. Their worshippers will try to pray it away.

objectives.text: Claim the hill shrine with four followers
Win the race to the shrine in the pass before the rival tribe
Keep the northern ley stone for 200 seconds: strike down rival worshippers who kneel at it

do.text: Select four followers and order them to worship the hill shrine.
The rival tribe has set out to pray at the stones!
Three wardens guard the ley stone. Garrison the Watchtower and cast Lightning on any rival worshipper who kneels there.
